function.name: CustomDashboardsApi_add_custom_dashboard

We might interpret they want to fetch it but can't because no function exists. We can respond explaining limitation. Or maybe they mean to create a dashboard named dashing? But phrase "get the dashboard" suggests retrieval. Since no function available, we should explain inability.
